newsitem.title: UK: CU up with market, aided by Q1 new business.
newsitem.headline: CU up with market, aided by Q1 new business.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc moved ahead on Wednesday in line with a firmer market and supported by buoyant first quarter new business, analysts said.
CU shares were up nine pence at 649p by 0750 GMT on volume of 285,000. The FTSE-100 index was up 34 points at 4,380.
Earlier, CU said new annual premiums in the first quarter were 28 percent higher at 74 million stg.
"The 28 percent is a much better first quarter figure than usual," said UBS insurance analyst Chris Hitching.
"The overall business has been helped by strong growth in Holland and CU seems to be getting its product distribution right in Italy," he added.
CU's new life, pensions and investment sales grew 25 percent to 853 million stg in the first quarter. The company's single premium sales rose 27 percent to 694 million pounds during the period.
